title: Malicious code in mrnima-openai-chatgpt-bot (npm)
description: The npm package 'mrnima-openai-chatgpt-bot' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised computer is strongly advised. However, removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence due to potential persistent backdoors or additional malware installed.
